ATTACHMENT 2 JUSTIFICATION & APPROVAL FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION for SIMPLIFIED ACQUISITIONS OVER THE MICROPURCHASE THRESHOLD (See FAR Part 2) UP TO SAT (See FAR 13.106-1) Date: 3/5/2026 PR Number: _________________________

1. Nature and/or description of the item/service being procured and its intended use (include the anticipated cost): The project will consist of removal of mold contaminated materials throughout a 1,200 sqft duplex unit including plywood underlayment, trim, paneling, and ceiling tiles. The areas under the structure where mold has been detected will be treated with chemical abatement processes. The abatement of asbestos will need to occur in conjunction with the mold remediation due to removal of plywood underlayment having linoleum that has tested positive for asbestos.

2. Sole Source Justification rationale (Check one and explain below):

______ Only one responsible source. ___X___ Urgent and compelling circumstances exist. Include critical delivery or performance dates, and when you became aware of the requirement. Provide a specific statement of the impact on Government operations, financial or otherwise, if the required delivery or performance dates are not met. ______ Other _____________________________________________________ Explain:

The park performed an annual inspection on December 9, 2025 at the concession operated building known as duplex cabin 9 and 10. During the inspection, facility staff identified soft areas along the floor and what visibly appeared to be mold growth throughout the duplex units. The park facility team made the decision to temporarily close the structure in conjunction with the concessioner to have the building properly tested for mold.

An inspection was conducted on January 8, 2026 at the concession operated building known as duplex cabin 9 and 10. The inspector identified mold throughout the building including ceiling, walls, and floors. Due to the severity of the mold and extensive damage to the structure materials, it was recommended to remove and discard both layers of ceiling, wall and trim finishings, cabinetry, plumbing and light fixtures, damaged insulation, floor coverings, and compromised subfloors. The underlayment that would need to be removed was determined to contain asbestos by previous testing reports which would require a company that could provide mold remediation as well as asbestos abatement.
